findings.message: The package has the legacy ESLint configuration .eslintrc.json and ESLint 10.13.0 installed. ESLint reads only an eslint.config.* file since version 9 (the legacy format needs ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false up to version 9 and is gone in version 10), so the project's own lint fails: no eslint.config.* file was found.
findings.title: The ESLint configuration is in a format the installed ESLint no longer reads

The likely cause is that the Check ran without the project's own tsconfig: path aliases, `paths`, project references, a custom `lib` or `types` setting and project-specific global types are not known to it. The type-aware rules see an unresolved import as `any` and report less there. Treat these results with care.
